summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, furnishing a press release of its Q1 2026 earnings results. The filing reports revenue of $90.4M, an adjusted EBITDA of $0.5M, and a share repurchase of 2.5M shares for $24.1M under a $200M plan. No merger, tender, restructuring, or activist event is described. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation filing.
